subject: Private deployment evidence ask — CAIQ / SIG / SOC 2 (EU pilot)
messages:
From: Liam Walsh <liam.walsh@medica-example.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: SaaSLegal <contracts@medica-example.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T17:15:00Z
Subject: Request: Private deployment evidence for EU pilot (CAIQ / SIG / SOC 2 items)

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As we move from pilot scoping into procurement, our security team has asked for a concise evidence packet covering the following for Redwood Private (EU pilot):

- CAIQ answers that map to private deployment controls (network isolation, peering, keystore operator separation)
- SOC 2 exhibits or pointers (particularly relevant controls for logical access and change management)
- Operator access roster and privileged access review cadence
- KMS/keystore partitioning statement and evidence of cross-tenant separation
- Recent key-rotation / audit logs for keystore operators (redacted OK)
- Diagram or narrative that shows VPC boundaries, peering, and egress controls for the EU physical zone

Can you provide an evidence index and estimated delivery date? If you have a CAIQ mapping spreadsheet, that would be ideal for our auditor. We need this to feed into our CAI (cloud assurance intake) by Oct 22 to stay on schedule.

Appreciate it — if you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min call with our security lead to walk through gaps.

Best,
Liam
Liam Walsh
Security Architect, Medica Health
liam.walsh@medica-example.com

Attachment: request_checklist.xlsx (see requested items list)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Liam Walsh <liam.walsh@medica-example.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T08:09:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Private deployment evidence for EU pilot (CAIQ / SIG / SOC 2 items)

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear list. We'll compile an evidence packet targeted at the items you called out. Quick notes and timeline so we're aligned: 

- What we'll deliver by Oct 20: index PDF (privatedeploy_evidence_index.pdf), CAIQ mapping spreadsheet (caIQ_mapping.xlsx), operator roster (operator_roster.csv), and a short narrative diagram of the EU VPC boundary and peering flows.
- What will follow (Oct 22–26): SOC 2 exhibit references and a redacted bundle of keystore rotation logs (audit_key_rotation_logs.zip). SOC 2 exhibits come from our control evidence store — I'll include exhibit-B for logical access and change mgmt as a pointer (soc2_exhibit-B.pdf).
- For KMS partitioning, I'll attach a short statement (kms_partition_statement.txt) and propose a 30-min technical call if your auditor wants a live walkthrough.

Two clarifying questions: 1) Do you need operator access with timestamps (last 12 months) or just the roster and review cadence? 2) Any special redaction rules for the audit logs?

If that plan works, we'll produce the index and mappings today and push the rest per the schedule. Attaching the index + roster stub to this message.

Thanks,
Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
Attachment: privatedeploy_evidence_index.pdf; operator_roster.csv

From: Liam Walsh <liam.walsh@medica-example.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: SaaSLegal <contracts@medica-example.com>, Audits Team <audits@medica-example.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T15:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Private deployment evidence for EU pilot (CAIQ / SIG / SOC 2 items)

Connor —

This looks good. Quick answers:
1) We need operator access with timestamps for the last 6 months (redacted UIDs OK).
2) Redact any tenant names and IP addresses if those are sensitive — replacing with placeholders is fine.

One additional ask from our compliance lead: a short explicit statement about cross-tenant KMS/keystore isolation and whether any operator processes require cross-tenant decryption privileges. If you cannot provide that statement, we will request a technical control call.

Also flagged: procurement may need an exception/annotation if any SOC 2 control evidence is in a US-located S3 bucket. Can you flag any such artifacts in your index?

We'll target Oct 22 for intake if you can hit the Oct 20 deliverable.

Thanks —
Liam

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Liam Walsh <liam.walsh@medica-example.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, SaaSLegal <contracts@medica-example.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T13:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Private deployment evidence for EU pilot (CAIQ / SIG / SOC 2 items)

Liam — thanks for the clarifications.

Per your asks: 
- Operator access: we'll include a timestamped CSV of privileged operator actions for the last 6 months with PII redacted (uid placeholders). That will be part of audit_key_rotation_logs.zip.
- Redaction: we'll replace tenant names and internal IPs with placeholders and include a redaction manifest.
- KMS isolation statement: attached (kms_partition_statement.txt). Short summary: Redwood Private uses per-customer key namespaces that are logically and cryptographically separated; operator processes do not possess cross-tenant decryption privileges in production. The statement points to our KMS partition architecture and controls.
- SOC 2 artifacts: the index will explicitly flag any artifacts stored in non-EU storage and provide a remediation/fallback note. Right now, exhibit B references are hosted in our control evidence store; the index will call out locations and access restrictions.

Next steps I will:
1) Upload the index + CAIQ mapping and roster to the shared Drive folder and post links (ETA: today).
2) Produce the redacted logs + SOC pointers (ETA: Oct 22).
3) Schedule a 30-min technical call if your auditor requests it.

If that timeline is acceptable I'll proceed.

—Connor

Subject: Internal: coordinating keystore export and redaction

Connor / Grace —

Quick internal note: security will produce the rotation logs and the timestamped operator actions, but we need signed approval on redaction rules from Liam before we hand over logs. I'll draft the redaction manifest (fields replaced, placeholders used) and attach it to the Drive folder. We should also confirm whether SOC 2 exhibits that live in US S3 can be mirrored to our EU evidence bucket for this intake (legal prefers mirroring rather than shipping cross-border artifacts).

Action items for us: 
- Grace: confirm the roster mapping to operator IDs and ensure we only include privileged role actions.
- Connor: once Liam confirms redaction rules, pass to security and I'll run the export (ETA 2 business days after confirmation).

Irene

Connor —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the KMS statement; that should cover the auditor's immediate questions. We reviewed the index and CAIQ mapping — a few minor clarifications requested inline in the Drive doc (I left comments).

Procurement noted the SOC 2 pointer that references US-hosted artifacts; they prefer the mirror option Irene mentioned. Can you confirm whether the exhibit mirrors will be available by Oct 26 so we can close the intake?

Assuming you can confirm mirror availability, let's schedule a 30-min call tomorrow at 09:00 CET to walk the auditors through the CAIQ mapping and the keystore separation diagram. DocuSign link for a standard NDA amendment is below — we'll execute once the mirror is confirmed.
